summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K announcing it delivered notice of termination of its Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, LTD., an affiliate of Yorkville Advisors Global. No specific financial terms (price/share, premium, break fee) were disclosed. The company stated it does not intend to make further use of this equity line of credit facility, reflecting a shift in financing strategy. The termination is effective immediately per the notice. The board did not issue a recommendation or name advisors for this action. This is a unilateral termination of a standby equity facility, not a merger or tender. Watch for any subsequent financing arrangements or capital structure changes.
